ThingDef.Name: RM_Reefback
ThingDef.label: reefback
ThingDef.description: So old the reef grows on it: coral, kelp, a hundred hangers-on that never leave. A moving ecosystem, and the one place in the deep where a crew can rest in the light of something else's garden — as long as nobody puts a harpoon in the garden.

ThingDef.label: young reefback
ThingDef.description: A reefback hatchling-sized by comparison only: the reef has barely begun to grow on it, and it drifts close to wherever the adults went.

ThingDef.label: warden mother
ThingDef.description: Barnacled, scarred, and older than anything else that swims these shallows — you can see it in how slowly she moves now. She goes wherever the water goes, and nowhere else; the few metres of dry ground between her and anything on land might as well be another world. Lethal to anything she can reach. Not tame, not tameable, and not gentle — but she remembers who freed her young from a drying pool, and she will not touch you for it.

BiomeDef.label: the Miasma
BiomeDef.description: A salt-crusted, stilt-rooted mangal forest standing in brackish channels between a dying sea and the rivers that feed it, under a green-gold haze of its own breath. Walking is hard, the air hangs thick, and the water crowds with life -- because everything ends up here: the water, the sins it carries, and the life running from the salt. Threaded through the stink, improbably, beauty: rainbow-hued plants, young animals everywhere, and the stubborn sense the place is on the verge of something.

BiomeDef.label: the Grey Sea
BiomeDef.description: A hypersaline terminal sea on the terminator band, its own endemic mat holding it alone the way the Twilight Sea's holds that one. Salt-encrusted and shrinking faster than its sister sea — the planet's chemical works, and the retreating shoreline is free surveying for anyone who can read the terraces.

li.quietText: Brackish water and soft roots, deadened by the salt. Nothing in the channels is any bigger than it looks.

li.label: nursery shallows
li.reading: Many small quick echoes in the brine shallows, and one larger, slower one keeping watch.

li.label: young things in the channel mud
li.reading: Small hard shells and soft bodies in the channel mud, a lot of them.

li.label: brined flotsam
li.reading: Salt-crusted metal thrown up by a surge, hollow and ringing dull.

li.label: void under the roots
li.reading: The echo falls into a hollow under the stilt roots.
